app.name: JunkSnap
app.tagline: Snap the junk. Prove it. Get it cleared.

common.comingSoon: This screen will be built soon.

auth.codeSent: A new code has been sent.
auth.verified: Email verified. You can log in now.

about.title: How JunkSnap works
about.intro: Snap a photo of waste, 10 people confirm it, and we draft a letter for the right authority.
about.cityText: How quickly the city clears waste and services bins.
about.citizenText: How much waste people are dumping.
about.binText: Whether people have a legal place to dump waste at all.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Network problem. Check your internet and try again.
errors.emailExists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a while.

snap.cameraDenied: Camera permission is blocked. Allow the camera in your browser settings and try again.
snap.cameraNotFound: No camera found on this device.
snap.cameraBusy: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.
snap.cameraInsecure: The camera needs a secure (HTTPS) connection.
snap.gpsDenied: Location permission is blocked. Allow location and try again.
snap.gpsUnavailable: Location is not available right now.
snap.gpsUnsupported: This device does not support location.
snap.gpsTimeout: Could not get your location. Move to an open area.
snap.problemNoGps: No location yet. Wait for GPS and retake the photo.
snap.problemPoorGps: GPS is too weak (needs ±{{max}} m or better). Move to an open area, wait, and retake.
snap.problemTooBig: The photo is larger than 8 MB.
snap.notePlaceholder: Anything that helps, for example: near the school gate
snap.savedText: We are checking your photo. Faces and number plates are blurred before anything is shown on the map, and other people need to confirm the site before it is verified.
snap.errStale: This photo is more than 10 minutes old. Please retake it.
snap.errRate: Too many reports this hour. Please try again later.
snap.errUpload: Photo upload failed. Check your internet and try again.
snap.queuedText: You are offline. We will send this report automatically when the internet is back. Photos older than 10 minutes cannot be sent, so please reconnect soon.

activity.empty: You have not reported anything yet.
activity.blurred: Blurred in your photo: {{faces}} faces, {{plates}} number plates
activity.failed: Something went wrong while checking this report. Our team will review it.

reject.unsafe_image: This photo was rejected because it looks unsafe. It has been deleted.
reject.no_waste_detected: We could not see waste in this photo. Please take a clearer photo of the site.
reject.duplicate_image: This photo looks the same as one you already reported.
reject.stale_photo: This photo was too old when it reached us. Please retake it.
reject.reporter_declined: You chose to discard this report.

confirm.question: We could not clearly see "{{type}}" in your photo. Does the photo really show it?
confirm.note: Other people still need to confirm the site before it is verified.
confirm.already: This report no longer needs your answer.

site.notFound: This site does not exist or has been hidden.
site.verifyProgress: Community verification in progress: {{count}} of {{total}} people have confirmed so far.
site.seatsNone: We could not find the ward or seat for this location yet.
